acceptance_gate: A runs a frozen exploratory census with an independent check; B proves its claims with checks; every census case agrees with the predictions or the disagreement is reported.
objective: Serves open question 3 of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md (composition) after CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001, which proved the top lemma and showed that knot top images are functional or overlapping at each variable, and recommended proving them functional (Latin hypercubes of the tops) and testing whether elimination forces group structure. Scoping found that every circuit that is functional modulo proper pp-definable equivalences already yields elimination, so the open question is exactly whether overlapping circuits can occur; that every overlapping candidate tried (the equality indicator, e = x + yH over Z_p) fails in systems of six to eight variables; that the 3-net laws of non-group Latin squares fail only in systems with shared labels; and that a 2x2 subsquare relation is functional exactly under Reidemeister's condition. A (exploratory census): 3-net laws of group and non-group Latin squares of orders 2 to 7, overlapping knots and controls; elimination, collapse of tops, top images of ties and knots, and Mal'tsev operations on knot tops. B proves that functional circuits compose like cycles (so composing like cycles is equivalent to Latin circuits modulo the tops exactly when no circuit overlaps), the Reidemeister link for 3-nets, and that the 3-net law of a finite abelian group composes like cycles exactly when it is a p-group.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. If every circuit is functional modulo common proper pp-definable equivalences the law composes like cycles, so composing like cycles with no overlapping circuit is exactly having Latin circuits modulo the tops; every overlapping candidate failed and all 65,159 census knot top images were functional, but the Latin conjecture is open. A 2x2 subsquare's relation is functional exactly for group isotopes (Reidemeister), and every non-group square tested failed. The 3-net law of a finite abelian group composes like cycles exactly for p-groups, with GF(p)-representable matroids; groups generated by the elements with u^m = 1 fail (S3, D4, Z6). Q8's 3-net survived the census with Latin knot images, yet no polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo its top (a 416-equation certificate): either it fails in larger systems or Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 is false. The census signal was false only through Q8. Next (owner's decision): decide whether the Q8 3-net composes like cycles (3/3).
stop_rule: Stop after B. Stop earlier if a law is found that composes like cycles in every sampled system and has an overlapping circuit modulo certified tops; that law would become the subject.
title: Knot top images of laws that compose like cycles
